title: 800 Series 36" Counter-Depth 3-Door Refrigerator
sub: Anti-fingerprint stainless steel, bar handles, ice and water at the door
lead: Bosch's 800 Series French door refrigerator at counter depth, in anti-fingerprint stainless steel with bar handles. Ice and filtered water come from the door, the QuickIce Pro System keeps the ice coming, and it runs at no more than 40 dBA.

features.name: QuickIce Pro System
features.line: Bosch's fast ice maker. Bosch puts it at 13 lb of ice a day: enough for the cooler and the glasses both.

features.name: Ice and water at the door
features.line: Filtered water and ice without opening a door. One touch fills a bottle, and the panel above shows the refrigerator and freezer temperatures.

features.name: Counter depth
features.line: The cabinet is 25 inches deep behind the doors, so the refrigerator keeps close to the line of the counters, with 21.6 cubic feet inside.

features.name: Humidity-controlled drawers
features.line: Two drawers with humidity control, and a full-width chiller drawer beneath them.

features.name: Anti-fingerprint stainless steel
features.line: A finish that guards against smudges and fingerprints, with bar handles.

also: Two-tier freezer drawer that pulls out full
Seven door bins, two of them gallon size
LED lighting inside and in the drawers
AirFresh filter, and an ethylene absorber included
UltraClarityPro water filter with a replacement indicator, first cartridge included
SuperCool and SuperFreeze: a colder setting for about eight hours
Wi-Fi with Home Connect, there if you want it: check and adjust it from a phone
specs: QuickIce Pro System, 13 lb a day
Ice and water at the door, one-touch bottle fill
VitaFresh; 2 humidity-controlled drawers; full-width chiller drawer
70 in; 70 5/8 with the leveling legs fully extended
